name: Ontology - backfill image source fields on already-enriched images

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: remove in v1.0.0. The source_uri and source_revision ontology mappings were added after images were already enriched. Layer enrichment skips an image that already has a source, and the base image schemas do not carry source fields, so those images are never reloaded and never get _ont_source_*. Copy both fields together so the ontology keeps the same source the native fields hold.
statements.query: MATCH (n) WHERE (n:AWSECRImage OR n:GCPArtifactRegistryImage OR n:GitLabContainerImage OR n:GitHubContainerImage OR n:ScalewayContainerRegistryImage) AND n.source_uri IS NOT NULL AND n._ont_source_uri IS NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE SET n._ont_source_uri = n.source_uri, n._ont_source_revision = n.source_revision
